lines.say: Bitcoins. On two large pizzas. May 22nd, 2010.

lines.cap: Laszlo Hanyecz, a programmer in Florida, posted online. I'll pay ten thousand bitcoins for two pizzas.
lines.say: Laszlo Hanyecz, a programmer in Florida, posted online. I'll pay ten thousand bitcoins for two pizzas.

lines.cap: A teenager in California took the deal, and ordered him two pizzas from Papa John's. At the time, those coins were worth about forty one dollars.
lines.say: A teenager in California took the deal, and ordered him two pizzas from Papa John's. At the time, those coins were worth about forty one dollars.

lines.cap: It was one of the first times anyone bought something real with bitcoin.
lines.say: It was one of the first times anyone bought something real with bitcoin.

lines.cap: At bitcoin's peak, those two pizzas were worth over a billion dollars.
lines.say: At bitcoin's peak, those two pizzas were worth over a billion dollars.

lines.cap: Laszlo says he doesn't regret it. Somebody had to show it could buy something.
